calls.title: Herschend & Growthbook Setup Questions
calls.summary: The discussion addressed the complexities of implementing feature flags for testing new features, noting that each test usually requires a new flag, thus increasing development workload. The team highlighted the limitations of the current user data layer, as it lacks customer profile information, which hampers effective segmentation for experiments. They also discussed the challenges of scaling tests across over 20 sites, which could slow down rollout and maintenance. Automation via Growth Book's MCP server was seen as a solution to reduce manual efforts in managing feature flags. The team agreed to conduct proof-of-concept tests on a small site within two to three weeks, and established a dedicated Slack channel for ongoing support during this initial testing phase.
calls.keywords: Feature Flags, Sticky Bucketing, MCP Server, AI Automation, Data Segmentation, Engineering Bottleneck
